SIM_TO_MOTHERSHIP_API_KEY.description: Runtime secret for Sim-to-Mothership calls (minimum 32 characters recommended)

MOTHERSHIP_RUNTIME_HEADER_MODE.description: Runtime auth header mode. Use legacy for pre-strict Copilot backends and strict for owned apps/mothership routes.

MOTHERSHIP_ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Mothership admin route secret (required when mothership.enabled=true)

API_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: API key encryption secret (required as 64 hex characters when mothership.enabled=true)

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.description: Public application URL (default http://localhost:3000 via envDefaults; set explicitly here to override in Secret)

INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL.description: Optional server-side internal base URL for internal /api self-calls (must include http:// or https://); defaults to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL when unset

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Authentication service URL (default http://localhost:3000 via envDefaults; set explicitly here to override in Secret)

NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL.description: Public socket URL; leave empty to default to the page origin (assumes reverse proxy routes /socket.io)

TRUSTED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated additional public origins to trust for auth (e.g. 'https://app.example.com,https://www.example.com'). Merged into Better Auth trustedOrigins.

SSO_TRUSTED_PROVIDER_IDS.description: Comma-separated SSO provider IDs to trust for automatic account linking when an SSO sign-in matches an existing account's email. Only needed for IdPs that do not assert email_verified. Merged into Better Auth accountLinking.trustedProviders.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key for transactional emails

EMAIL_DOMAIN.description: Domain for sending emails (fallback when FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS not set)

AWS_SES_REGION.description: AWS region for SES (e.g., 'us-east-1'). Credentials are resolved via the standard AWS provider chain (env vars, IRSA, EC2/ECS task role, SSO).

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname. When set together with SMTP_PORT, enables the SMTP mail provider.

SMTP_PORT.description: SMTP server port. 465 = implicit TLS, 587 = STARTTLS, 25 = plain.

SMTP_USER.description: SMTP username (optional — leave empty for unauthenticated relays like MailHog).

SMTP_PASS.description: SMTP password (optional — leave empty for unauthenticated relays).

SMTP_SECURE.description: Set to 'true' to force TLS on connect. Defaults to true when SMTP_PORT=465.

DISABLE_GOOGLE_AUTH.description: Set to 'true' to hide Google OAuth login even when credentials are configured

DISABLE_GITHUB_AUTH.description: Set to 'true' to hide GitHub OAuth login even when credentials are configured
